issue.title: sase-core flake: bead_read_model_parity::concurrent_readers_see_consistent_snapshots finds the cache stale at line 934 on CI

task_type_fields.evidence:
Fails on GitHub Actions CI, mostly ubuntu-latest (earlier also macos-latest), always at
crates/sase_core/tests/integration/bead_read_model_parity.rs:934, i.e. the final
`assert!(verify.compared, "{}", verify.reason)` with reason "cache is stale: the next read
rebuilds". The earlier snapshot-membership and parity assertions pass, so the test did not
observe wrong issue contents; the cache verifier declined to compare because the cache file
was never refreshed.

Observations (lead CI research, 2026-10-29):
- In the 120 most recent failed sase-core CI runs (master pushes and release-plz PRs,
  2026-10-08 to 2026-10-29), 12 runs carry this line-934 "cache is stale" failure; the
  "concurrent read served a state no replay ever produced" assertion appeared in only one
  (run 37912989918, 2026-10-09).
- First seen 2026-10-13 (run 38439181389), i.e. before b12e5815 merged the integration
  tests into one binary, and it recurs after the 2026-10-18 freshness-stamp CAS fixes and
  after closed sase-1io.7.1 ("Make the sase-core read-model cache safe under concurrent
  access").
- Current master tip cd62c83d is red on it (run 40807288117); 0fd85e4a too (run
  40797498289). Its predecessor 95dc0c10 (release-steward-only change, identical cache code)
  was green, so it is intermittent, not deterministic.
- Previously recorded only as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP / phase notes (sase-1pi.1, sase-1io.6,
  sase-1io.2) and never filed as its own bead.

Mechanism hypothesis (consistent with the code, not yet reproduced): in
crates/sase_core/src/bead/read_model/store.rs, `rebuild_from_replay` calls
`mark_failed_rebuild` on any `Fault::Cache` that is not a lost generation race (for example
a REBUILD_BUSY_TIMEOUT busy failure while the 4 reader threads and the appender contend).
That arms the process-global FAILED_REBUILD_BACKOFF (10 minutes) for this cache path, so
every later read in the test, including `resync`/`assert_parity`, is served by replay and
never refreshes the cache file; `read_model_verify_cache` then probes it as stale.
Confirm by including the cache diagnostic (`cache_diagnostic`) in the assertion message or
by forcing a busy rebuild failure under the injected-failure test hook.

Fix direction: if confirmed, a transient busy/locked rebuild failure probably should not arm
the 10-minute replay-only backoff (that also degrades production readers for 10 minutes).
Do not weaken or drop the verify assertion (sase-core AGENTS.md forbids weakening
assertions).

Not reproduced locally or serially in this research; no unchanged-SHA rerun was performed.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (in a sase-core checkout); CI: cargo fmt + clippy + test (ubuntu-latest)

issue.creation_reason: This intermittent sase-core test is the failure keeping master red right now and has been noted as a proposed follow-up on at least three beads without ever becoming owned work; filing it so a worker can confirm the backoff mechanism and fix it.

payload.description: Closed concurrent-access hardening of the same read-model cache; this failure recurs after it
